Serves as a junior analyst at the IMCOM Headquarters level performing a variety of analytical duties for one or more program areas. Assists supervisor or senior program analyst in the administration of processes and analytical support associated with assigned program areas.

Determines data required for analysis and devises appropriate methods for securing required information from sources such as reports, surveys, on-site investigations, discussions with officials, statutes, policies, plans, schedules, etc. Analyzes issues, selects and applies accepted analytical techniques.

Must include at least one year of experience performing duties at a level which equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities needed to perform successfully in the position. Applicants must have experience performing work similar to the duties listed above.

Documented experience must have been equivalent in complexity and difficulty to the next lower grade/level. Possess knowledge of the basic principles, concepts and methodologies required to perform various analytical techniques and develop initial conclusions.

Possess experience collecting and determining the data required for analysis and creating methods for measuring performance. Possess experience working collaboratively to develop strategies to address and resolve problems.

Possess demonstrated experience using Microsoft Power applications, especially developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards All answers to the Highly Qualifying Criteria must be demonstrated in your resume to get credit.

The Department of Energy's mission is to ensure America's security and prosperity by addressing its energy, environmental and nuclear challenges through transformative science and technology solutions.

The Office of Cybersecurity, Energy Security and Emergency Response works to strengthen the security and resilience of the U.S. energy sector from cyber, physical, and climate-based risks and disruptions.

We are truly honored that DOE has been named America's #1 Best Employer for Veterans in 2023 by Forbes-not only among Government agencies, but among employers across the U.S. We are so proud of this ranking which reflects our commitment to the employment of veterans.

As so many veterans at DOE renew their service to our Nation, we are deeply committed to their success and advancement.

Veterans shape the future of energy As a Management and Program Analyst, you will: Serve as a senior analyst and advisor to program office leadership, providing expert technical guidance, strategic alternatives, and evaluative recommendations on complex programs with office-wide or department-wide impacts.

Monitor, analyze, and oversee the preparation of situation reports, threat assessments, and mitigation strategies regarding cyber and physical incidents impacting national energy sector infrastructure.

Design, implement, and evaluate management information and administrative reporting systems, establishing data collection methodologies and metrics to measure program performance and efficiency.

Review and analyze federal legislation, executive orders, national strategies, and agency policies to determine their operational impacts on emergency response and security programs, translating findings into actionable internal guidelines.

Prepare and deliver comprehensive briefings, risk updates, and technical summaries to senior agency leadership, interagency partners, state and local authorities, and private industry executives.

Lead program planning, project management, and budget development activities-particularly in coordination with National Laboratories to build and maintain critical incident response and threat analysis capabilities.
SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: A qualified candidate's online application and resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level GS-14 in the Federal service.

Specialized experience for this position is defined as meeting 2 of the following 3: Leading senior-level coordination, situational analysis and response strategies for cyber or physical security incidents, hazards or emergency disruptions impacting national or industry-wide critical infrastructure.

Preparing technical reports, risk summaries or situational updates to senior leaders and stakeholders to guide decision-making during sensitive or emergency events. Updating emergency response plans and disaster recovery protocols to identify capability gaps and improve organizational readiness. "Experience" refers to paid and unpaid experience.

Examples of qualifying unpaid experience may include: volunteer work done through National Service programs (such as Peace Corps and AmeriCorps); as well as work for other community-based philanthropic and social organizations.

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills; and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. Limit your resume to no more than two (2) pages.

If more than two pages are submitted, only the first two pages will be reviewed to determine your eligibility and qualifications. Your full resume will be made available to the hiring manager if you are referred.

Analyzes data generated from a variety of sources (e.g. corporate data warehouse, Vista, DSS, FDCS) to identify and report issues by provider, program clinic, and service.

Analyzes and evaluates on a quantitative or qualitative basis the effectiveness of medical facility program operations ni meeting established goals and objectives. Identifies and manages the data streams essential to the operations, organization, and decision-making process with VACC.

Analyze new or proposed legislation or regulations to determine impact on medical facility programs. Applies clinical, demographics, and administrative systems to develop information and data systems specific to VACC.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Advises and assists the RPO Division Director/Senior Manager, Director RPO, and Management in resolving critical, sensitive, or confidential matters related to employee relations, i.e., Labor Relations, National Treasury Employees Union (NTEU), or litigation issues.

Brief Job Description
The Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC) is seeking experienced candidates for a Systems Analyst V (DevOps Coordinator) position within Access & Eligibility Services (AES), Data Management & Reporting. The position supports HHSC mission-critical technology initiatives through senior-level business analysis, systems analysis, governance participation, solution validation, release coordination, and operational decision support.
Systems Analyst V functions as a senior individual contributor with primary responsibility for business analysis, requirements management, project intake assessment, governance participation, solution validation, and stakeholder coordination.

The position serves as a liaison between business and technical teams and is responsible for discovery, documentation, testing coordination, release readiness, and operational support activities associated with complex information technology initiatives.

The role works under minimal supervision and exercises considerable latitude for initiative and independent judgment. These positions do not have formal supervisory authority.
Essential Job Functions (EJFs)
Business Analysis, Governance & Portfolio Management (30%)
Leads discovery sessions, stakeholder interviews, and requirements elicitation activities for IT projects and operational initiatives.
Identifies, analyzes, documents, and validates business, functional, operational, and system requirements.
Participates in project intake, governance reviews, portfolio planning activities, and assessment of enhancement requests and backlog items.
Works with business areas, technical teams, and governance portfolio stakeholders to assess initiative scope, business value, benefits, risks, dependencies, and operational impacts.
Develops business cases, impact assessments, and recommendations to support decision making and prioritization activities.
Provides recommendations to leadership regarding project prioritization, feasibility, implementation considerations, and business outcomes.
Develops and maintains business requirements, business rules, workflows, process models, use cases, mockups, technical specifications, and related project artifacts.
Evaluates current business processes and identifies opportunities for automation, standardization, operational efficiency, and improved customer experience.
Project Coordination, Testing & Release Management (30%)
Coordinates project activities involving development, testing, validation, implementation, and production support.
Develops and coordinates validation strategies to ensure solutions satisfy documented business requirements.
Coordinates solution validation, testing activities, user acceptance testing, defect review, and verification of requirements fulfillment.
Reviews test scenarios, test results, and defect resolution activities to verify requirements are fully met.
Maintains requirements traceability through validation, testing, implementation, and post-release activities.
Acts as the primary coordination point between business stakeholders and technical teams for release readiness activities.
Coordinates release planning, implementation schedules, stakeholder communications, release approvals, deployment readiness, and post-release validation activities.
Ensures business stakeholders are informed of release impacts, risks, dependencies, and implementation timelines.
Systems Analysis, Documentation & Operational Support (30%)
Analyzes business and technical processes to support application enhancements, system improvements, and operational needs.
Develops, reviews, and maintains business, technical, operational, testing, and system documentation.
Develops and reviews complex system artifacts including business rules, requirements, diagrams, flowcharts, technical specifications, system design documents, test plans, technical reference manuals, and production control manuals.
Supports application operations through troubleshooting, issue analysis, root cause investigation, and coordination with development and support teams.
Implements and supports proactive monitoring, alerting, reporting, and trend analysis activities.
Improves and documents departmental processes, standards, procedures, and style guidance.
Provides technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and cross-training to team members and coworkers.
Organizational Support & Strategic Planning (10%)
Facilitates meetings, workshops, and discussions with executive leadership, business stakeholders, and technical teams to achieve consensus and support decision-making.
Participates in governance reviews, portfolio discussions, technology planning, roadmap discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Communicates effectively through written communications, meetings, presentations, and briefings to technical and non-technical audiences.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs)
Knowledge of business analysis, requirements management, system analysis, validation, testing, implementation, and operational support practices.
Knowledge of project governance, portfolio management, project intake, backlog assessment, and prioritization processes.
Skill in Microsoft Visio, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Office Suite, and requirements management/documentation tools.
Skill in developing diagrams, process flows, decision trees, and business documentation for technical and non-technical audiences.
Skill in facilitating discovery sessions, stakeholder discussions, requirements workshops, and solution validation activities.
Ability to assess competing priorities, evaluate business value and risk, and make recommendations regarding project and backlog prioritization.
Ability to facilitate meetings, workshops, and discussions with executive leadership, business stakeholders, and technical teams to achieve consensus and support decision-making.
